sources.articleTitle: Stacy Keach, Mike Hammer actor whose career spanned stage and screen, dies aged 85
Stacy Keach, star of "Mike Hammer" TV series and stage, dies at 85

headline: Stacy Keach, Star Of Mike Hammer And Stage Actor, Dies At Age 85
metaDescription: Actor Stacy Keach, known for his portrayal of private investigator Mike Hammer and an extensive career on stage and screen, has passed away at 85.
aiSummaryBullets: Actor Stacy Keach, recognized for his role as Mike Hammer, has died at the age of 85.
His death occurred in Poland following a prolonged struggle with heart conditions.
Keach maintained a career across stage and screen that spanned several decades.
aiContextParagraph: Stacy Keach was a prominent American performer known for his work in theater, television, and film. He gained widespread public recognition for his portrayal of the private investigator Mike Hammer in a television series. Throughout his professional life, Keach established himself as a versatile stage actor, appearing in numerous productions. Beyond his career highlights, his public biography included a period of legal difficulty in 1984, when he was imprisoned for attempting to smuggle cocaine into Britain. According to his wife, his passing occurred in Poland after he faced a long and difficult battle with heart failure and other heart-related medical conditions. The actor was 85 years old at the time of his death. His career is noted for its transition between classic stage performances and prominent television roles, marking a significant presence in American entertainment history.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to the death of a well-known veteran actor, appearing across multiple major media outlets.
